Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 29: the slip of [[Nute Gunray's Bounty (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on Amidala or opponent's senator. During your move phase, unless a Jedi here, your alien bounty hunter present may capture and seize that character. During your control phase, if that character is escorted by an alien, opponent loses 1 Force.”), word for word the text of [[Nute Gunray's Bounty]]. The label under the slip reads “•Accepting Trade Federation Control (V)”, as printed in the Master List.<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
